title: DSPLA/21/2004 of STATE Vs BICHHAN LAL

paras.text:
DSPLA No.21/2004
Honíble Dharam Veer, J.
(Delay Condonation Appn. No.1/04)
 Sri M.A. Khan, learned brief holder for the State/appellant.
 Notice was issued to the respondent on the application u/s 5
of Limitation Act, which has been served on the respondent but
none appeared on behalf of the respondent.
 The grounds shown in the affidavit filed along with the delay
condonation application are sufficient to condone the delay.
 Delay is condoned.
 The delay condonation application is allowed.
 I have also perused the judgment and order dated 04.05.2004
passed by Additional Sessions Judge/F.T.C., Tehri Garhwal in
Sessions Trial No.31/99, State Vs. Bichhan Lal as well as perused
the trial courtís record.
 Leave to appeal is granted.
 Admit the appeal.
 Issue fresh notice to the respondent-Bichhan Lal, returnable
within four weeks.
 List thereafter in due course.
